name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: fd2_ prefix, domain 'chapter_17' (17 is a meaningful chapter ID in range 01-30 and must be preserved -- not address residue), descriptor 'post_action' accurately reflects the per-chapter turn-cycle post-action handler role. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Chapter 17 turn-cycle post-action handler: runs the default win/lose check then adds a compound lose condition tied to the swordsmaster 蜜蒂.
logic_summary: Dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table[16] (table @ 0x51B19, indexed by current_chapter_id); event_arg (the pushed active char_idx) is unused. Body: (1) call fd2_check_battle_end_condition() for the default win/lose decision; (2) if fd2_check_party_has_char_id(0x12) == 0 (party no longer permanently contains 蜜蒂, char_id 0x12) AND fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x34) != 0 (her runtime slot is dead), then call fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=2, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, blink=1) and set data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code = 1 (LOSE). The char-id check short-circuits: when 蜜蒂 is still present the dead-check and dialog are skipped. Disasm confirmed: PUSH 0x12/CALL fd2_check_party_has_char_id, JNZ skip; PUSH 0x34/CALL fd2_check_char_is_dead, JZ skip; dialog operand is dword ptr [0x53a79] (= data_fd2_current_chapter_text); MOV dword ptr [0x53ecc],1.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: cdecl arg the dispatch site pushes (active char_idx) and cleans with ADD ESP,4; unused by the body (the leading __CHK(0x28,...) prologue is a Watcom stack-check artifact). Generic name shared across all handlers in this file.
params.reason: Reasonable generic name for this dispatched-handler signature; the body does not use it, so a domain-specific name would not be more accurate. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; observable effect is the conditional write of data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (=1 LOSE) plus the dialog render side-effect.

notes: char_id 0x12 = 蜜蒂 verified via fd2-knowledge KB (code_hacks.md: '12 = 蜜蒂'; '0D是貝克威，12才是蜜蒂') and chapter_17.md (蜜蒂 必出; if not joined she still fights but leaves after the chapter -- matching this handler's compound lose logic). Callee names all match src: fd2_check_battle_end_condition @ 0x205be, fd2_check_party_has_char_id @ 0x33499, fd2_check_char_is_dead @ 0x3453e, fd2_display_dialog_scene @ 0x15f84. Source comment and Ghidra plate are consistent and accurate -- no edits made; no source diff this commit (shard only).
